title: Manufacturing Sulphuric Acid
subtitle: An important commodity chemical used across many industries
sidebar_desc: Sulphuric Acid is a very important commodity chemical and is used in fertilizer manufacture.
content:
SULPHURIC ACID MANUFACTURING COMPLEX

  • Two sulfuric acid manufacturing plants with minimum concentration of 98%. Total production capacity: 120 M.T./day.
  • Two Sulphuric Acid dilution plants to manufacture 78%, 51%, and 35% concentrations.
  • Two Reverse Osmosis plants for Demineralised Water production.
  • Automatic Loading Arm for Bulk Tanker Filling.

PRODUCT USES

Used in fertilizer production, mineral processing, oil refining, wastewater treatment, lead-acid battery manufacturing, and chlorine dioxide generation.

PRODUCT QUALITY

  1. DIN EN 899 - Standard for chemicals for water treatment for human consumption.
  2. BS 3031:1996 - Specification for Sulphuric Acid for lead-acid batteries.
  3. ASTM E 1011-96 - Specification for Sulphuric Acid for industrial applications.

SUPPLY POSSIBILITIES

Fleet of stainless steel Bulk Tankers. Supply also available in Bulk Road Tankers, Ultratainers, IBCs, HDP Drums, and 20L HDP Cans.

title: Manufacturing Engine Coolants
subtitle: We have been manufacturing Engine Coolants over the past 25+ years
sidebar_desc: Highly cost-efficient and fully organic engine coolants. Recommended to change the coolant annually.
content:
Highly cost-efficient and fully organic. Recommended to change the coolant annually. Organic Acid Additive Technology (OAT) provides long-lasting corrosion protection.

Applications:

  • Electric Vehicles
  • Wind Industry and Power Generation
  • On- and Off-road Applications
  • Marine and Rail Applications
  • Light Duty Vehicles, Buses, Pick-ups and Vans

  • Japanese, Korean, Indian, European, American, and Chinese Vehicles
